title: Maintenance Intelligence — Reliability (ISO 14224)
description: MTBF/MTTR trends, failure mode distributions, and fleet availability sourced from failure_events and equipment_units tables.

list.name: site_id
list.label: Site
list.query: SELECT site_id AS __text, site_id AS __value FROM sites ORDER BY name

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(dt.op_hours) > 0 THEN ROUND((SUM(dt.op_hours) / (SUM(dt.op_hours) + SUM(dt.down_hours)))::numeric, 4) ELSE NULL END AS availability FROM (SELECT COALESCE(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - fe.failure_start_ts))/3600, 0) AS op_hours, COALESCE(fe.downtime_hours, 0) AS down_hours FROM failure_events fe WHERE fe.failure_start_ts >= now() - interval '${window_days} days') dt
SELECT COUNT(*) AS failures FROM failure_events WHERE failure_start_ts >= now() - interval '${window_days} days'
SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(downtime_hours), 0)::numeric, 1) AS downtime_hours FROM failure_events WHERE failure_start_ts >= now() - interval '${window_days} days'

SELECT COALESCE(eu.tag, fe.asset_id, 'Unknown') AS worst_asset FROM failure_events fe LEFT JOIN equipment_units eu ON fe.equipment_unit_id = eu.equipment_unit_id WHERE fe.failure_start_ts >= now() - interval '${window_days} days' GROUP BY eu.tag, fe.asset_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(AVG(mtbf)::numeric, 0) AS avg_mtbf FROM (SELECT equipment_unit_id, (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - MIN(failure_start_ts)))/3600 - COALESCE(SUM(downtime_hours),0)) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS mtbf FROM failure_events WHERE failure_start_ts >= now() - interval '${window_days} days' AND equipment_unit_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY equipment_unit_id) sub WHERE mtbf > 0
SELECT ROUND(AVG(downtime_hours)::numeric, 1) AS avg_mttr FROM failure_events WHERE failure_start_ts >= now() - interval '${window_days} days' AND downtime_hours IS NOT NULL AND downtime_hours > 0

SELECT COALESCE(fm.name, fe.failure_mode_code, 'Unclassified') AS mode, COUNT(*) AS count FROM failure_events fe LEFT JOIN iso_failure_modes fm ON fe.failure_mode_code = fm.code WHERE fe.failure_start_ts >= now() - interval '${window_days} days' GROUP BY fm.name, fe.failure_mode_code ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 12

SELECT COALESCE(fc.name, fe.failure_cause_code, 'Unclassified') AS cause, COUNT(*) AS count FROM failure_events fe LEFT JOIN iso_failure_causes fc ON fe.failure_cause_code = fc.code WHERE fe.failure_start_ts >= now() - interval '${window_days} days' GROUP BY fc.name, fe.failure_cause_code ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT COALESCE(fmech.name, fe.failure_mechanism_code, 'Unclassified') AS mechanism, COUNT(*) AS count FROM failure_events fe LEFT JOIN iso_failure_mechanisms fmech ON fe.failure_mechanism_code = fmech.code WHERE fe.failure_start_ts >= now() - interval '${window_days} days' GROUP BY fmech.name, fe.failure_mechanism_code ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 12

SELECT fe.failure_start_ts AS time, COALESCE(eu.tag, fe.asset_id, 'Unknown') AS metric, fe.downtime_hours AS value FROM failure_events fe LEFT JOIN equipment_units eu ON fe.equipment_unit_id = eu.equipment_unit_id WHERE fe.failure_start_ts >= now() - interval '${window_days} days' ORDER BY fe.failure_start_ts

SELECT COALESCE(eu.tag, fe.equipment_unit_id) AS equipment, ROUND(((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - MIN(fe.failure_start_ts)))/3600 - COALESCE(SUM(fe.downtime_hours),0)) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0))::numeric, 0) AS mtbf_hours FROM failure_events fe LEFT JOIN equipment_units eu ON fe.equipment_unit_id = eu.equipment_unit_id WHERE fe.failure_start_ts >= now() - interval '${window_days} days' AND fe.equipment_unit_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY eu.tag, fe.equipment_unit_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ORDER BY mtbf_hours ASC LIMIT 20

SELECT COALESCE(eu.tag, fe.equipment_unit_id) AS equipment, ROUND(AVG(fe.downtime_hours)::numeric, 1) AS mttr_hours FROM failure_events fe LEFT JOIN equipment_units eu ON fe.equipment_unit_id = eu.equipment_unit_id WHERE fe.failure_start_ts >= now() - interval '${window_days} days' AND fe.downtime_hours IS NOT NULL AND fe.downtime_hours > 0 AND fe.equipment_unit_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY eu.tag, fe.equipment_unit_id ORDER BY mttr_hours DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT COALESCE(eu.tag, fe.equipment_unit_id) AS equipment, COALESCE(eu.iso_equipment_class, '') AS iso_class, COALESCE(eu.equipment_family, '') AS family, COALESCE(eu.criticality, '') AS criticality, COUNT(*) AS failures, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(fe.downtime_hours), 0)::numeric, 1) AS total_downtime_h, ROUND(AVG(fe.downtime_hours)::numeric, 1) AS avg_mttr_h, ROUND(((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - MIN(fe.failure_start_ts)))/3600 - COALESCE(SUM(fe.downtime_hours),0)) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0))::numeric, 0) AS mtbf_h, CASE WHEN (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - MIN(fe.failure_start_ts)))/3600) > 0 THEN ROUND(((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - MIN(fe.failure_start_ts)))/3600 - COALESCE(SUM(fe.downtime_hours),0)) / (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - MIN(fe.failure_start_ts)))/3600))::numeric, 4) ELSE NULL END AS availability FROM failure_events fe LEFT JOIN equipment_units eu ON fe.equipment_unit_id = eu.equipment_unit_id WHERE fe.failure_start_ts >= now() - interval '${window_days} days' AND fe.equipment_unit_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY eu.tag, fe.equipment_unit_id, eu.iso_equipment_class, eu.equipment_family, eu.criticality ORDER BY availability ASC NULLS LAST

SELECT COALESCE(ma.name, fe.maintenance_action_code, 'Unclassified') AS action, COUNT(*) AS count FROM failure_events fe LEFT JOIN iso_maintenance_actions ma ON fe.maintenance_action_code = ma.code WHERE fe.failure_start_ts >= now() - interval '${window_days} days' AND fe.maintenance_action_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ma.name, fe.maintenance_action_code ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT COALESCE(dm.name, fe.detection_method_code, 'Unclassified') AS method, COUNT(*) AS count FROM failure_events fe LEFT JOIN iso_detection_methods dm ON fe.detection_method_code = dm.code WHERE fe.failure_start_ts >= now() - interval '${window_days} days' AND fe.detection_method_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY dm.name, fe.detection_method_code ORDER BY count DESC

panels.title: Failure Events by ISO Equipment Class

targets.rawSql: SELECT REPLACE(eu.iso_equipment_class, '_', ' ') AS equipment_class, COUNT(*) AS failures, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(fe.downtime_hours), 0)::numeric, 1) AS total_downtime_h FROM failure_events fe JOIN equipment_units eu ON fe.equipment_unit_id = eu.equipment_unit_id WHERE fe.failure_start_ts >= now() - interval '${window_days} days' GROUP BY eu.iso_equipment_class ORDER BY failures DESC
